title: Zephyr: Rule 3 decompression
description: Implement Rule 3 decompression in Zephyr C. Acceptance: decompresses to original headers, cross-validates.
notes: Implemented current-spec Zephyr wire Rule 3 decompression for canonical link-local IPv6 + ICMPv6 RPL DIO; stale parent IPv6/UDP wording does not control. Decoder now enforces the 22554-byte encoded profile ceiling, rejects every truncated 39-byte residue, unknown rule IDs, and undersized output atomically, parses the exact byte-aligned 312-bit residue, preserves the following opaque RPL option tail, writes elided flags/reserved as zero, bounds reconstructed lengths, and rebuilds IPv6/ICMPv6/DIO lengths/checksum. The residue has no padding bits because it is exactly byte aligned. Validation: sanitizer-backed focused C PASS 1/1; Rule 3 compression, Rule 4 compression/decompression, and Rule 7 regressions PASS 4/4; Python Rule 3 PASS 16; Rust canonical/header/profile tests PASS 3; cppcheck PASS.
close_reason: Implemented and cross-validated atomic current-spec Zephyr SCHC Rule 3 decompression
